name: alfacode-team/hkm-plugin-mqtt
description: HKM Kernel plugin providing 'pubsub.mqtt' — a native MQTT 3.1.1 / 5.0 client (QoS 0-2, retain, will, shared subscriptions, TLS) and the kernel's PubSubPort over it. No MQTT library.

suggest.ext-openswoole: Not required. With it, the client's blocking reads yield the coroutine instead of the worker — which is what lets one process hold an MQTT subscription and thousands of WebSocket connections at once.

extra.//: No MQTT library. The protocol is fifteen packet types over a two-field fixed header, and the parts that are easy to get wrong are the parts a dependency's defaults hide: whether the Remaining Length varint is bounded before it is believed, whether a wildcard in a PUBLISH topic is refused or silently delivered to nobody, whether the Client Identifier is unique per PROCESS (a duplicate makes the broker disconnect the other holder), whether a subscriber sends PINGREQ inside the keep-alive window, and whether the TLS decision comes from configuration or from the port number.
